records.title: PlantCAD2: A DNA foundation model for interpreting genomes across flowering plants.

scope.decision_rationale: PlantCAD2 is a primary DNA foundation model, but the evidence only supports biological sequence modeling: single-nucleotide tokenization and masked language modeling on genomes, with no natural-language text or text-bio bridge.
scope.evidence_snippet: single-nucleotide tokenization and masked language modeling objective; 8,192-bp input sequences; DNA language model on angiosperms

architecture.decision_rationale: This is a pre-trained DNA language model, but the provided evidence centers on masked language modeling and masked-token prediction rather than a genuinely generative architecture. It does show broad pretraining on 65 angiosperm genomes and transferable zero-shot use.
architecture.evidence_snippet: masked language modeling objective; masked token prediction accuracy; pre-trained on 65 angiosperm genomes; zero-shot testing shows transferable performance across species

records.title: OCellus: A Language-Model Framework for Single-Cell, Spatial, and Perturbation Biology with Natural-Language Reasoning

scope.decision_rationale: OCellus is a new multimodal language-model framework with explicit natural-language reasoning, a natural-language interface, and generated explanations grounded in biological tasks.
scope.evidence_snippet: natural-language interface; generates natural-language explanations of its own outputs; Planner-Router-Verifier natural-language interface

architecture.decision_rationale: The system does generate natural-language explanations, but the core stack is a Qwen3.5-9B backbone plus LoRA adapters, a plugin GNN, and an agent layer rather than a new generative foundation model. The evidence supports a wrapper built around an existing LLM.
architecture.evidence_snippet: a single nine-billion-parameter language model (Qwen3.5-9B); generates natural-language explanations of its predictions; a Planner-Router-Verifier natural-language interface

records.title: GEM-GPT Enables Personalized Cell Type-Resolved Therapeutic Design for Systems Pharmacology.

scope.decision_rationale: GEM-GPT is a primary generative system for transcriptomics-conditioned molecule design, but the provided evidence does not show a natural-language text component; it describes an scRNA-seq foundation model and a molecular GPT model.
scope.evidence_snippet: transcriptomics-based molecule generation framework; couples a single-cell RNA-sequencing foundation model with a molecular GPT model

architecture.decision_rationale: The paper explicitly presents a transcriptomics-based molecule generation framework and describes generation of personalized therapeutic compounds. It also combines a single-cell RNA-seq foundation model with a molecular GPT and shows cross-cell-type generalization.
architecture.evidence_snippet: transcriptomics-based molecule generation framework; couples a single-cell RNA-sequencing foundation model with a molecular GPT model; generate distinct molecules for different cell types

records.title: Building Knowledge-Enhanced AI Co-Scientists for Biomedical Discovery

scope.decision_rationale: spEMO is a wrapper-style system that plugs in external PFMs/LLMs and GPT-4o/o1 for downstream clustering and report generation, rather than a new text-bio foundation model.
scope.evidence_snippet: integrating external knowledge as embeddings extracted from FMs; generate medical reports with a multi-modal instruction setting; GPT-4o and o1

architecture.decision_rationale: The selected text describes a system built around a shared Qwen3.5-9B backbone and external foundation models, including report generation via GPT-4o and o1. That makes it an application framework/wrapper rather than a primary generative foundation model.
architecture.evidence_snippet: spEMO can generate medical reports with a multi-modal instruction setting; Our multi-modal agents used in this task are GPT-4o and o1; shared Qwen3.5-9B backbone

records.title: scDifformer: diffusion-based post-training for virtual cell modeling across large-scale single-cell data

scope.decision_rationale: scDifformer is a primary single-cell transformer/diffusion model, but the evidence is transcriptome-token modeling and diffusion post-training with no natural-language text component.
scope.evidence_snippet: masked language model pre-training, diffusion-driven post-training; 36.77 million human single-cell transcriptomes; rank value encoding

architecture.decision_rationale: This is a genuinely generative model paper because it adds a denoising diffusion module to masked-language-model pretraining and uses diffusion-based post-training. The corpus is large-scale and the model is framed as a foundation for virtual cell modeling across studies.
architecture.evidence_snippet: context-aware transformer model augmented with a denoising diffusion module; diffusion-driven post-training; 34.2 million cells included for further analysis

records.title: Geometric Representations of Knowledge Inside Biological Large Language Models: an Empirical Analysis

scope.decision_rationale: This is a systematic empirical analysis of existing single-cell foundation models, not a new candidate model; the evidence concerns evaluation geometry and metadata-rich benchmarks.
scope.evidence_snippet: systematic empirical analysis of four SCFMs; 0.42M-cell atlas panel with rich metadata; comparing every measurement against baselines

architecture.decision_rationale: The record is an empirical analysis of existing single-cell foundation models, not a new generative model paper. It studies representational geometry and probe behavior across scBERT, Geneformer, scGPT, and UCE.
architecture.evidence_snippet: We conduct a systematic empirical analysis of four SCFMs spanning 8.9M–650M parameters; across six families of analyses

records.title: Lineage-Independent Structural Risk Detection in SARS- CoV-2 Spike Protein via Zero-Shot Protein Language Modeling

scope.decision_rationale: The framework uses ESM-2 zero-shot for spike-protein risk scoring, which is an application of an existing protein LM without a substantive text component.
scope.evidence_snippet: applies the protein language model ESM-2, without fine-tuning on epidemiological outcome labels; zero-shot structural risk quantification

architecture.decision_rationale: The framework applies an existing protein language model, ESM-2, in a zero-shot scoring setup rather than introducing a new generative model. The evidence is a wrapper around masked-token likelihood scoring for risk quantification.
architecture.evidence_snippet: applies the protein language model ESM-2, without fine-tuning; masked-token log-likelihood ratios; zero-shot structural risk quantification

scope.decision_rationale: The provided section shows literature-derived gene regulatory network construction and mentions an LLM, but the title is truncated and the candidate model/bridge is not clear enough to classify confidently.
scope.evidence_snippet: PubTator3 table (relation2pubtator3.gz); integrated with a large language model (LLM); gene regulatory relationships from publications

architecture.decision_rationale: The provided evidence is too truncated to establish a generative architecture or a foundation-model-like candidate. What is visible is a literature-derived network construction step, not a generative text-bio foundation model.
architecture.evidence_snippet: Gene regulatory relationships were obtained from the pre-annotated PubTator3 table; integrated with a large language model (LLM)

records.title: Miniaturizing and modifying natural proteins with Raygun

scope.decision_rationale: Raygun is a generative protein design model, but the provided evidence only shows protein sequence embeddings and no natural-language text component. The text-bio bridge is not supported beyond biological language-model embeddings.
scope.evidence_snippet: "probabilistic encoding of protein sequences constructed from language model embeddings"; "auto-encoder operating on ESM-2 embeddings"

architecture.decision_rationale: Raygun is explicitly described as an auto-encoder with decoder-side generation and generative sampling. It is also pretrained on ~80,000 UniRef50 proteins and used for broad sequence modification tasks.
architecture.evidence_snippet: "auto-encoder"; "support generative sampling"; "trained on around 80,000 proteins from UniRef50"; "single-shot generation"

records.title: Unify learns cellular evolution with universal multimodal embeddings

scope.decision_rationale: Unify combines scRNA-seq with protein- and general-purpose language-model embeddings to build cell embeddings. The language side is auxiliary feature injection for a transfer-learning predictor, not a primary text-bio generative model.
scope.evidence_snippet: "combining RNA expression with embeddings from protein language models and general-purpose language models"

architecture.decision_rationale: Unify is presented as a transfer learning framework for universal cell embeddings and cross-species prediction, not a generative architecture. The evidence supports broad transferable representations but not generation.
architecture.evidence_snippet: "learns universal cell embeddings"; "transfer learning methodology"; "combining RNA expression with embeddings"; "prediction of perturbation responses across species"

records.title: scMIR: a vision-language foundation model for single-cell light microscopy image representation

scope.decision_rationale: scMIR is presented as a vision-language foundation model with paired microscopy images and textual captions. The text-guided cross-modal alignment makes the text-bio bridge central to the model.
scope.evidence_snippet: "paired single-cell images and structured textual captions"; "text-guided cross-modal alignment"

architecture.decision_rationale: scMIR is a pretrained vision-language foundation model with strong transferable representations, but the provided sections only show self-supervised image reconstruction and text-guided alignment. They do not clearly establish a genuinely generative text-bio mechanism.
architecture.evidence_snippet: "self-supervised image reconstruction with text-guided cross-modal alignment"; "pretrained on 207,957 image-text pairs"; "task-agnostic image embeddings"

records.title: CellDuality: Unlocking Biological Reasoning in LLMs with Self-Supervised RLVR.

scope.decision_rationale: The method frames biological reasoning as LLM prompts and textual outputs over cell and perturbation representations. That makes the text component and text-bio bridge explicit in the candidate model.
scope.evidence_snippet: "all inputs to the LLM are constructed as textual prompts"; "The model's output is a textual response"

architecture.decision_rationale: CellDuality fine-tunes and steers an existing LLM for biological reasoning with SFT and self-supervised RLVR, so the contribution is an application wrapper rather than a new foundational model. The record does show autoregressive text generation, but not candidate-model foundation pretraining.
architecture.evidence_snippet: "output is a textual response y, generated autoregressively according to the policy"; "leveraging powerful teacher models"; "Supervised Fine-Tuning"; "RLVR"
